requirements_summary: Primary: VS Code extension with token-streaming completions and inline suggestions that appear within <50ms ideally and certainly <120ms tail. Need per-user and per-session rate limits; ability to pin model per extension release; automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant on capacity pressure. Deployment: test on Redwood hosted first; eventual Dedicated pool for production with VPC peering. Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging of prompts, KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for subset of users. Observability: per-route latency & token-cost, tracing hooks for streaming sessions, sample traces for 95/99 percentiles. Billing: want estimates for sustained vs burst token usage and a cap option for trial. POC success metric: 95th percentile inline suggestion latency <120ms and token cost within forecasted ARR band.
internal_notes: Customer metric-driven; will push for Dedicated if POC shows stable SLOs. SE flagged need for streaming backpressure knobs and token-cost dashboard before procurement. Keep competitor watch on GitHub Copilot policy and Tabnine enterprise pricing.
